Both DDA and DIA acquisition modes were used across different experiments. SILAC was specifically used for the intercellular immunosynapse experiments, while other experiments used LFQ.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment uses a specialized proximity labeling technique (LUX-MS) that converts photo-oxidized residues (primarily Histidine) into biotinylation sites via hydrazone formation. While the search parameters for the initial discovery of modifications were complex, the final proteome-wide analysis used standard tryptic search parameters with common modifications.
